title: Engineers catchup prep - Dylan Chen & Priya Rao
body:
Context:
- Weekly catch-up with Priya (IC3, inference kernel dev). Focus: short-term delivery, unblockers for quantization path, career development check, and sync on on-call rotation handover.
- Tone: quick, actionable, leave with 2–3 concrete next steps.

Meeting details
- When: Mon 2026-05-04 10:30am PT (30m)
- Where: Zoom (link in calendar)
- Goals: remove at least one blocker, align on release plan for v2.7 kernels, check career pulse, capture action items and owners.

Agenda (30m) - timeboxed
1) 0–3m: quick opening + mood check
   - "How's your week? Any fires?" (keep light)
2) 3–12m: Delivery status (JIRA INF-2143 / INF-2301)
   - Current state of quantized aten kernel (PR 879): tests flaky on Ampere 2 nodes.
   - Ask: what repro steps tried? any perf regressions? rough ETA?
3) 12–20m: Blockers deep dive (aim to identify root cause and owner)
   - Memory corruption suspicion when sequence length > 2048.
   - Hypothesis: kernel uses 32-bit offsets in a helper; check patch xform.
   - Quick mitigation: roll back to fallback kernel for affected tests (tradeoff: perf).
4) 20–26m: Career / growth check (5–7m)
   - Progress on shipping leadership goals (mentoring junior devs, leading kernel design session).
   - Ask about stretch project interest (reliability-on-chip scheduling).
5) 26–30m: Wrap & actions
   - Confirm owners, dates, any follow-ups for next sync.

Notes to self (prep snippets)
- Bring up perf delta numbers (locally: +7% p99 token time on RTX A10G when using quantized path).
- Remind to ask whether Priya wants me to block CI on the PR or to iterate in place.
- If she asks for more headcount, note more context needed (concrete impact, duration, pair program plan).
- Keep career talk short but meaningful: one win, one growth area, one ask.

Open questions for meeting
- Has Priya run the repro on the Dedicated GPUs (region-us-west2) or only on shared dev infra?
- Who owns the native lib upgrade (libcuda 525 -> 530) and timeline? PR?
- Is there a flaky test that masks the regression (test name: test_kv_cache_overflow)?

Quick decisions I can make during meeting (authority checklist)
- Approve short-term fallback to non-quantized kernel for the flagged testcases (I can OK, if perf hit acceptable).
- Greenlight 2-week pairing allocation with SRE for memory debugging (limit 2 days/week).
- Defer hiring asks to weekly hiring sync unless she presents clear scope.

Draft follow-ups / action items (capture during meeting)
- Action: Run deterministic repro on dedicated A100 (owner: Priya) | due: 2026-05-06
- Action: Add CI gating for the quantized path (owner: Dylan) | due: 2026-05-08
- Action: File small memory-check PR to add asserts in helper offsets (owner: Priya) | due: 2026-05-05
- Action: Schedule 2 x 90m pairing sessions with SRE (owner: Dylan) | due: 2026-05-07
- Action: Capture career OKR progress and draft 1 growth project proposal (owner: Priya) | due: 2026-05-18

Possible follow-up phrases to send in slack after meeting
- "Thanks — following up on the actions: can you paste the CI failure links? I'll add the CI gating ticket and start the rollback on monday if repro holds."
- "For the pairing sessions I scheduled: please pick times that aren't during deep-focus windows; I'll book from my calendar."

Prep artifacts to check beforehand
- Re-run PR 879 on dev-A100-02 (note machine: dev-a100-02)
- Look at recent core dumps in /var/crash (ask SRE if needed)
- Scan CI history for test_kv_cache_overflow last 30 days (tagged in JIRA INF-2301)

Notes after meeting (placeholder for capture)
- (X) Priya confirmed repro on dedicated A100; memory traces attached to Jira INF-2143.
- (X) We agreed temporary CI gate for quantized path until memory fix.
- ( ) Dylan to open infra ticket for rolling kernel fallback.

Emotional / managerial notes
- Priya seems engaged but stretched; workload > 1.2 FTE — check bandwidth long-term.
- Offer: propose 3-month experiment reallocating 0.2 FTE from infra-utility to kernel work to unblock delivery.

Random scratch ideas (brainstorm)
- Could we add a lightweight sanitizer run as a nightly on a single A100 node (cheap way to catch mem issues)?
- Try toggling 64-bit offsets build flag in PR to see if it changes failure surface.

End-of-doc reminders
- Capture actions into Jira and calendar follow-ups immediately post-meeting.
- Mark this doc as copy -> team notes if the kernel issue expands.
_note: Informal scratchpad; intentionally choppy. Keep private under users/.
